description.value: Coyote Cruises rents inner tubes and luxury party islands for a leisurely float down the 7-kilometre Penticton Channel, the natural waterway connecting Okanagan Lake to Skaha Lake. A shuttle bus returns floaters to the starting point, and the operation sells dry bags and waterproof cases to protect valuables. It is consistently rated one of Penticton's top summer bucket-list experiences, making it a natural stop for touring cyclists spending time in the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and richly detailed, confirming an active seasonal tube-float business on the Penticton Channel. OSM's address field was incomplete ('Riverside Drive' only); the website consistently lists '215 Riverside Drive, Penticton BC V2A 8M0' and a phone number absent from OSM. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so all such fields are null.
concerns: OSM address field is incomplete ('Riverside Drive' only); website consistently shows '215 Riverside Drive, Penticton BC V2A 8M0' — used website value.
OSM has no phone number; website lists +1 (250) 486-5755 — contact_confirmed.phone set to null as no OSM value to compare against.
Business is seasonal; website banner states 'CA OPENING June 22, 2026', so the listing is not relevant outside summer months.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Coyote Cruises is a well-established, actively operating Penticton attraction that touring cyclists would genuinely enjoy; its location on the Channel and easy shuttle logistics make it a practical and popular day-stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website; all such fields are null pending an on-site visit or direct inquiry.

wow_evidence: The classic 7 km Penticton channel float with tube rentals and return shuttle — a genuinely beloved, day-shaping summer experience.
blurb: Tube float down Penticton's 7 km channel between Okanagan and Skaha lakes.
